title: Pipeline Analysis Finding
description: Schema for finding.json — a per-group structured finding written by AI during Phase 3 root-cause analysis. Validated by the orchestrator immediately after the analysis agent completes.

group_id.description: Slug identifier for the failure group, used in directory paths (e.g. '01-numpy-constraint-conflict').

title.description: Short descriptive title summarizing the failure group.

collections.description: Collections affected by this failure group. Can be empty for non-collection-specific groups.

actions.description: Pipeline actions that failed (e.g. ['build-wheels']). When a group spans multiple (collection, action) pairs, lists all unique actions.

error_summary.description: Human-readable one-line summary of the error.

suggested_resolution_summary.description: One-line summary of the suggested fix.

has_resolution_file.description: Whether a sections/resolution.md file exists with detailed resolution steps.

confidence.description: Confidence level in the root-cause diagnosis.

confidence_justification.description: Evidence and reasoning supporting the confidence level.

cascade.description: Whether this failure cascades from an upstream failure rather than being an independent root cause.

group_consistency.description: Whether all jobs show the same error symptoms ('consistent') or exhibit different error manifestations despite sharing a root cause ('mixed'). Same root cause with variant-specific symptoms = 'mixed'.

feedback_status.description: Whether workflow feedback was written. 'included' when feedback.md was written, 'not_applicable' when no process observations apply.

path.description: Canonical repository path consulted during analysis.

description.description: How this reference was used during the investigation and what insight it provided.

references.description: Repository files consulted during analysis, with descriptions of how each was used.

transient.description: Whether the failure is transient -- likely resolvable by retrying the failed job(s) without any code or configuration changes. Set true only when the root cause is an external, non-deterministic infrastructure issue (e.g., connection resets, DNS resolution failures, HTTP 429/502/503/504 from upstream services, registry connection refused). Do not set true for certificate verification failures, authentication errors, manifest-not-found, or network errors during hermetic build phases. See transient-patterns.md for detailed criteria. When true, the orchestrator may auto-retry the job (up to a bounded maximum) instead of filing a Jira ticket.

target_repo.description: Full URL of the GitLab repository where the fix should be applied (e.g. 'https://gitlab.com/redhat/rhel-ai/rhai/pipeline'). Omit when the fix location is unclear or no code fix exists.

target_repo_reason.description: 1-2 sentence justification for why target_repo was chosen (e.g. which files need changing and why they live in that repo).

domain_enrichment.description: Domain-specific metadata added by a domain skill hook. Present only when the domain_skill field was set in rca-context.json and the hook produced valid enrichment.

domain_skill.description: Name of the domain skill that produced this enrichment.

metadata.description: Domain-specific classification data. Schema is defined by the domain skill, not by pipeline-rca.

description.description: How this documentation was used and what insight it provided.

agent_docs.description: Agent documentation files consulted during analysis.

description.description: How this skill was used and what it accomplished.
How this tool was used beyond baseline operations.

tools.description: Tools used during analysis beyond what the prompt explicitly instructed.
